# TPC-DS-OBT Q67

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  *
FROM (
  SELECT
    item_i_category,
    item_i_class,
    item_i_brand,
    item_i_product_name,
    sold_date_d_year,
    sold_date_d_qoy,
    sold_date_d_moy,
    store_s_store_id,
    sumsales,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY item_i_category ORDER BY sumsales DESC) AS rk
  FROM (
    SELECT
      obt.item_i_category,
      obt.item_i_class,
      obt.item_i_brand,
      obt.item_i_product_name,
      obt.sold_date_d_year,
      obt.sold_date_d_qoy,
      obt.sold_date_d_moy,
      obt.store_s_store_id,
      SUM(COALESCE(obt.sales_price * obt.quantity, 0)) AS sumsales
    FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
    WHERE
      (
        obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk
        AND obt.item_sk = obt.item_i_item_sk
        AND obt.store_sk = obt.store_s_store_sk
        AND obt.sold_date_d_month_seq BETWEEN 1176 AND 1176 + 11
      )
      AND channel = 'store'
    GROUP BY
      ROLLUP (
        obt.item_i_category,
        obt.item_i_class,
        obt.item_i_brand,
        obt.item_i_product_name,
        obt.sold_date_d_year,
        obt.sold_date_d_qoy,
        obt.sold_date_d_moy,
        obt.store_s_store_id
      )
  ) AS dw1
) AS dw2
WHERE
  rk <= 100
ORDER BY
  item_i_category,
  item_i_class,
  item_i_brand,
  item_i_product_name,
  sold_date_d_year,
  sold_date_d_qoy,
  sold_date_d_moy,
  store_s_store_id,
  sumsales,
  rk
LIMIT 100
```
